{
    "content": "<p>Using IE8 Standards Mode with MOSS has been fairly trouble-free so far. However,\nthe richhtmlfield editor throws javascript errors when the page is in IE8\nStandards mode. Without switching to the Telerik control or defaulting <strong>all</strong>\nof my pages to IE7 mode - there is a simpler fix!</p>\n<p>Enable IE7 compatability mode only on your edit pages. My master page had the IE8 meta\ntag:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-html\">&lt;meta equiv=&quot;X-UA-Compatible&quot; content=&quot;IE=8&quot; /&gt;\n</code></pre>\n<p>right under the head element. To force your edit\npages into IE7 mode, use the <code>PublishingWebControls:EditModePanel</code> to\nconditionally display it. Directly under the head element should now look\nlike:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-html\">&lt;publishingwebcontrols:editmodepanel\n    id=&quot;EditModePanel1&quot;\n    runat=&quot;server&quot;\n    suppresstag=&quot;true&quot;&gt;\n    &lt;meta equiv=&quot;X-UA-Compatible&quot; content=&quot;IE=7&quot; /&gt;\n&lt;/PublishingWebControls:EditModePanel/&gt;\n&lt;meta equiv=&quot;X-UA-Compatible&quot; content=&quot;IE=8&quot; /&gt;\n</code></pre>\n<p>Yay.</p>\n",

        "rawInput": "\nUsing IE8 Standards Mode with MOSS has been fairly trouble-free so far. However,\nthe richhtmlfield editor throws javascript errors when the page is in IE8\nStandards mode. Without switching to the Telerik control or defaulting **all**\nof my pages to IE7 mode - there is a simpler fix!\n\nEnable IE7 compatability mode only on your edit pages. My master page had the IE8 meta\ntag:\n\n```html\n<meta equiv=\"X-UA-Compatible\" content=\"IE=8\" />\n```\n\nright under the head element. To force your edit\npages into IE7 mode, use the `PublishingWebControls:EditModePanel` to\nconditionally display it. Directly under the head element should now look\nlike:\n\n```html\n<publishingwebcontrols:editmodepanel\n    id=\"EditModePanel1\"\n    runat=\"server\"\n    suppresstag=\"true\">\n    <meta equiv=\"X-UA-Compatible\" content=\"IE=7\" />\n</PublishingWebControls:EditModePanel/>\n<meta equiv=\"X-UA-Compatible\" content=\"IE=8\" />\n```\n\nYay.\n",
        "url": "/posts/2009-10-26-ie8-standards-mode-and-moss/",

    },
